# PREMA Vedic Astrology (Ashtakoota & Guna Milan) Skill

## Overview
Authoritative mathematical rules for calculating Vedic Astrology compatibility (Ashtakoota / Guna Milan 36 Points system) and Graha/Rashi alignments.

---

## ☸️ Ashtakoota 36 Guna Milan System

Calculated based on Moon Sign (Rashi) and Moon Nakshatra (Lunar Mansion) of both individuals:

| Koota (Factor) | Max Points | Area Evaluated | Description & Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nadi** | 8 | Health & Genetic Compatibility | Adi, Madhya, Antya Nadi. Same Nadi = Nadi Dosha (0 pts) unless exception rules apply. Different Nadi = 8 pts. |
| **Bhakoot** | 7 | Emotional Alignment & Growth | Relative Moon sign placement (1/7, 2/12, 3/11, 4/10, 5/9, 6/8). 6/8 and 2/12 cause Bhakoot Dosha (0 pts) unless rashi lord is same. |
| **Gana** | 6 | Temperament Alignment | Deva (Divine), Manushya (Human), Rakshasa (Dominant). Deva-Deva = 6, Deva-Rakshasa = 0 or 1. |
| **Graha Maitri** | 5 | Mental Compatibility & Friendship | Friendship between Moon Sign Lord planets (e.g. Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn). Friend/Friend = 5 pts. Enemy/Enemy = 0 pts. |
| **Yoni** | 4 | Physical & Intimate Affinity | 14 Animal Yonis (Horse, Elephant, Sheep, Serpent, Dog, Cat, Rat, Cow, Buffalo, Tiger, Deer, Monkey, Lion, Mongoose). Friendly = 4, Enemy = 0. |
| **Tara** | 3 | Destiny & Wellbeing Alignment | Count from Nakshatra 1 to Nakshatra 2 mod 9 (Janma, Sampat, Vipat, Kshema, Pratyak, Sadhak, Vadha, Mitra, Ati-Mitra). |
| **Vashya** | 2 | Mutual Influence & Attraction | Dwipada, Chatushpada, Jalachara, Vanachara, Keeta. Matching categories receive up to 2 pts. |
| **Varna / Lagna** | 1 | Ego & Spiritual Alignment | Varna alignment based on rashi element (Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra). |

---

## 🔴 Manglik Dosha Rules
- Mars placement in Houses 1, 4, 7, 8, or 12 relative to Lagna/Moon.
- Evaluate Manglik cancellation rules (e.g. Mars in own/exalted sign, matching partner Manglik status).
- Never present Manglik status as a fear factor; present it as a balanced energy indicator.
